verdict.rationale: The app documents its own extension mechanism: users can add MCP servers and skills from a Library in Settings, and all models share those tools. That is a plausible way to connect external workflow tools. However, no evidence names Jira, Slack, Google Drive or any prebuilt connectors for them, so delivery of the specific integrations is unproven. Missing for 10: named first-party integrations for Jira/Slack/Google Drive, documentation of the Library's available connectors, setup/auth details for those services, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: Add skills and MCP servers from the Library in Settings. Every model sees the same skills and tools.
